Oracle Corporation is an American multinational technology company specializing in database software, enterprise applications, and cloud infrastructure. Founded in 1977, Oracle offers a comprehensive suite of products and services that address various aspects of corporate information technology environments, including applications and infrastructure technologies. The company markets its solutions through independent software and hardware vendors, system integrators, and resellers, with operations spanning across the globe. Oracle is headquartered in Austin, Texas, United States.

PayPal Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational financial technology company operating an online payments system in the majority of countries that support online money transfers; it serves as an electronic alternative to traditional paper methods such as checks and money orders. The company operates as a payment processor for online vendors, auction sites, and many other commercial and company users.
Publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol PYPL

McDonald's Corporation is the world's leading global foodservice retailer, operating and franchising McDonald's restaurants. As of fiscal year-end 2025, McDonald's had approximately 40,000+ restaurants across more than 100 countries. The company's core business model is built around franchising — the vast majority of restaurants (roughly 95%) are operated by franchisees, with the company acting primarily as a franchisor, real estate owner, and brand steward. McDonald's strategy centers on its "Accelerating the Arches" long-term growth plan, emphasizing core menu items, digital engagement, delivery, and development.
110 N. Carpenter St., Chicago, IL 60607, USA

Nike, Inc. is an American multinational corporation that designs, develops, manufactures, and markets athletic footwear, apparel, equipment, and accessories worldwide. It is the world's largest supplier of athletic shoes and apparel and a major manufacturer of sports equipment, with revenue in excess of US$46 billion in its fiscal year 2022.
Publicly owned with no controlling shareholder; ownership is distributed among institutional investors, mutual funds, and individual shareholders worldwide.
Nike World Headquarters, Washington County, Oregon, US

PepsiCo, Inc. is an American multinational food and beverage corporation headquartered in Harrison, New York. The company was formed in 1965 through the merger of the Pepsi-Cola Company and Frito-Lay, Inc. PepsiCo's diverse product portfolio includes beverages, snacks, and other food items, with notable brands such as Pepsi, Tropicana, Quaker Oats, and Gatorade. The company operates globally, serving customers in over 200 countries and territories. As of 2024, PepsiCo reported annual net revenues exceeding $70 billion, making it the second-largest food and beverage business worldwide, behind Nestlé. The company's flagship product, Pepsi Cola, has been engaged in a longstanding rivalry with Coca-Cola, commonly referred to as the cola wars. Despite this competition, PepsiCo remains a dominant player in the North American market, holding the position of the largest food and beverage company by net revenue. Ramón Laguarta has been serving as the Chief Executive Officer since 2018.
700 Anderson Hill Road, Purchase, NY 10577, USA
